title: Read-only Pilot Observation
intent: Gather platform metadata without write authority or operational side effects.
problem: Without read-only capability and deterministic metadata snapshots prohibit writes, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the read-only pilot observation contract.
context: This pattern addresses an owned platform is analyzed before integration; its concrete control is read-only capability and deterministic metadata snapshots prohibit writes.
forces: Correctness requires that pilot execution has no mutation route
Operational pressure can cause: read credentials unexpectedly allow writes
solution: Implement read-only capability and deterministic metadata snapshots prohibit writes. Verify the anchored symbol `PilotManifestError` with `test_checked_in_mjn_manifest_is_reproducible_and_read_only` before reuse.
invariants: pilot execution has no mutation route
snapshot digest identifies the analyzed input
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `read credentials unexpectedly allow writes` and fails closed if the read-only pilot observation evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For read-only pilot observation, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to read-only capability and deterministic metadata snapshots prohibit writes.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: an owned platform is analyzed before integration
Do not apply when: the task requires modifying the platform
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: an owned platform is analyzed before integration
not_when: the task requires modifying the platform
